name: Hum Palm
description: Press a palm forward with a low hum so that the shaking of the air lands as a shove on the chest.

name: Tuning Breath
description: Hum one steady note through each breath until the qi settles to the same slow beat and steadies the user's next move.

name: Shiver Guard
description: Set a shivering skin of air before the body so that a blow loses its edge in the trembling.

name: Chime Step
description: Push off the floor on a short ringing note and arrive a pace to one side.

name: Ringing Tap
description: Tap a fingertip on the target so that the shake of the tap rings through the muscle beneath.

name: Echo Ping
description: Send a thin pulse of sound outward and read the shape of the nearest wall or body from the echo that returns.

name: Rattle Fist
description: Close the fist round a shaking pulse of qi and strike so the rattle carries past the skin.

name: Dull Thrum
description: Keep a slow low thrum going about the chest so that glancing blows are deadened before they land.

name: Count Step
description: Move on the count of a single drum beat and gain a pace in the half breath between beats.

name: Pulse Count
description: Lay two fingers on a body or a post and count the pulse of what moves inside it.

name: Sounding Jab
description: Jab straight out and let a sharp crack of sound leave the knuckles a moment before the blow.

name: Drumbeat Cover
description: Beat the forearm against an incoming strike with a hard pulse of qi that knocks the strike off line.

name: Steady Tone
description: Sing one level tone through the throat until the hands stop shaking and the next strike goes true.

name: Air Shake
description: Clap the hands to shake the air before the foe's face so that their aim slips for a heartbeat.

name: Cupped Clap
description: Cup both hands and clap them against the foe's side so the trapped air bursts against the ribs.

name: Quiver Sheet
description: Hold a quivering sheet of air at arm's length that dulls thrown stones and weak blows.

name: Soft Slide
description: Glide a pace sideways on a cushion of damped air so that the feet make no sound.

name: Whisper Reach
description: Stretch the hearing out past the walls of the room to catch the faint breathing of those beyond.

name: Calming Hum
description: Hum a slow level note over an ally or the self so that the shaking of fear and shock eases and bruised muscle relaxes.

name: First Ring
description: Strike a hard surface or a guard at its own note so that the ring runs back up the foe's arm.

name: Settle Note
description: Find the note that the body rings at and hold it until breath and qi lock into a steady pace.

name: Brush Tremor
description: Brush a striking limb aside with a short shake that spoils its line and robs it of weight.

name: Quick Pitch
description: Rise on the ball of the foot as if on a rising pitch and cross two paces in a flicker.

name: Listen Thread
description: Run a thread of sound along a rope or a wall and hear where it is cut or hollow.

name: Listening Ear
description: Turn the hearing to one sound among many and follow it until its source is known.

name: Tap Rhythm
description: Tap a quick pattern of three light blows that shake the foe's guard loose before the fourth lands hard.

name: Muffle Cloak
description: Wrap the body in a layer of deadened air that swallows both noise and the weight of light strikes.

name: Tick Step
description: Take short steps in time with a ticking pulse so that the movement hides inside its own rhythm.

name: Drone Press
description: Pour a heavy droning note at one foe until the pressure of it slows the legs and dulls the wits.

name: Pitch Lift
description: Raise a rising note in the chest to quicken the pulse and sharpen the reflexes of the user.

name: Resonant Knuckle
description: Rap the hard knuckle on a joint at its ringing point so the whole limb buzzes and goes numb.

name: Bone Hum
description: Set the long bones humming in unison so that each strike travels through the whole frame.

name: Marrow Knock
description: Knock the heel of the hand against the foe's arm so the shock settles deep in the bone.

name: Humming Guard
description: Keep the forearms humming so that every blow met by them is shaken apart on contact.

name: Skip Beat
description: Drop out of the foe's rhythm with one skipped beat and come back a pace closer.

name: Bone Listen
description: Press the brow to a floor or a post and read the footsteps that come through it.

name: Knock Away
description: Rap the flat of the hand against a blade or fist so that the shake spoils its line.

name: Pitch Strike
description: Strike with a high thin note sharpening the blow to a point that the foe cannot spread.

name: Heartbeat Mend
description: Lay a hand on an ally or the self and time the qi to the pulse so that a small wound closes and bleeding slows.

name: Wave Parry
description: Meet a thrust with a small outward wave that bends it wide of the body.

name: Pulse Step
description: Spring on the upbeat of the pulse so the body is already moving when the foe's blow arrives.

name: Sound Probe
description: Send a thin tone at a closed door or chest and listen for what sits behind it.

name: Low Pitch
description: Drop to a deep rumble that settles on the foe's chest and slows the breathing.

name: Steady Wave
description: Hold a slow even wave of qi round the body so that sharp shocks spread out and lose their bite.

name: Tremble Palm
description: Strike with the open palm and let a tremor run out of it into the foe's body.

name: Shake Loose
description: Shake the foe's grip with a quick buzz of the hand on the wrist so that the weapon sags.

name: Level Hum
description: Hum a level tone against a strained muscle or sprain so that the shaking tissue settles and relaxes.

name: Slide Beat
description: Slide the lead foot out on the beat and bring the rear foot after on the half beat.

name: Ear Reach
description: Spread the hearing round the body like a bowl and catch the faint sounds of anything approaching.

name: Settling Palm
description: Lay the palm on a striking arm and let a short hum drain the force out of the blow.
